title: Partnerships Manager
description:
The company
It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.
manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.
manda is part of iwoca , one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.
We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda ( iwoca 's M&A Platform)
We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca 's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.
The role
Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.
Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca 's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.
You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.
It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.
Key responsibilities include:
Build the introducer network

• Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

• Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

• Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

• A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

• Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

• Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

• Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and pa

No matter where you are or how you get the job done, you have what you need to be successful and connected. The mark of true success at Wave is the ability to be bold, learn quickly and share your knowledge generously.

The Senior Analyst, Fraud Prevention & Detection is a hands-on fraud risk professional responsible for identifying fraud patterns, evaluating controls, and improving prevention and detection strategies across digital customer and payment experiences. This role analyzes account activity, transaction behavior, payment flows, model outputs, case trends, and other risk signals to identify emerging threats and recommend practical control improvements.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town - we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Product Marketing at Faire is a strategic function embedded across the product lifecycle. PMMs partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Revenue to shape programs from the ground up, develop positioning and messaging, lead GTM strategy, and drive awareness and adoption. We have PMMs focused on each side of the marketplace: the brands who sell on Faire, and the retailers who buy from them.

We're looking for a senior product marketer who can own a meaningful product area, build GTM strategy from scratch, and grow their remit over time as business needs shift. This is a role for someone who makes complex products feel simple to customers, moves comfortably between strategy and execution, and brings clarity to ambiguous problems across a cross-functional team.

Positioning and messaging

• Develop deep customer understanding for your product area and translate those insights into clear, compelling positioning.

• Make Faire feel simple to customers. Cut jargon, kill messaging that doesn't matter, and push back on product complexity that won't land.

• Sharpen the positioning of products that already have a story, repositioning them so they land with a new or shifting audience.

• Hold the thread across multiple launches in your area, surfacing a coherent narrative rather than a stack of individual product stories.

GTM strategy and execution

• Build and own end-to-end GTM strategy for your product area, from positioning through launch and adoption.

• Ship directionally right launches fast. Comfortable making calls with 70% of the information and adjusting after, rather than waiting for perfect.

• Execute across multiple channels, sequencing customer education to drive behavior change at the right moments in the journey.

• Coordinate cross-functional enablement across Revenue, CX, Lifecycle, and other partners to bring GTM plans to life.

• Act as a customer-centric thought partner to Product, Design, Legal, and other stakeholders as your products evolve. Get involved upstream and shape roadmaps through customer insight.

Team and craft

• Spend real time with customers and bring their POV into strategic conversations. Ground decisions in research and feedback rather than internal assumptions.

• Use AI tools to sharpen and accelerate your work, and contribute to a culture of peer learning on the PMM team around how we experiment with and adopt AI.

Qualifications

Required

• 6+ years of product marketing experience, or an adjacent role with direct ownership of positioning, messaging, sales enablement, and GTM strategy for complex products.

• Track record of building positioning from scratch and reworking the positioning of existing products, then driving consistency across multiple channels.

• Builder who makes order from chaos. Comfortable when the path isn't obvious, and energized by the chance to create structure where there is none.

• Experience building thematic campaigns across product areas, not just siloed launches.

• Uses data to size opportunities, measure impact, and pressure-test strategy. Fluent in the metrics that move the business.

title: Senior Exploration Geologist
description:
About the company
In the coming decades, our world needs far more critical minerals including copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.
KoBold is the leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs-by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.
Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.
KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.
KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.
About the position
In this role, you will lead evaluations of potential properties for acquisition, generate targets, and design and oversee field programs from target definition through to resource expansion. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team and will work closely with data scientists, using KoBold’s technology to help guide our field programs and decision-making. You will also work directly with our senior technical advisors and with the executive team on making the investment case for acquisitions and field programs.
Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by identifying opportunities with rigorous evaluation and by ensuring that we safely and effectively conduct our field programs.
Responsibilities

• Demonstrate in all activities a commitment to the highest standards in health and safety, environment, and community relations

• Rigorously analyze geoscientific datasets across a range of scales from provinces to prospects to determine exploration potential and to identify, rank, and prioritize exploration targets

• Design, budget, permit, and execute field programs ranging from geological mapping and sampling of grass roots prospects through to large drilling programs on advanced projects, with leading industry practice in data acquisition and validation

• Provide technical guidance and support to local in-country project teams during the design and execution of exploration programs, including site visits and engagement with other project stakeholders (e.g., community representatives, regulatory authorities, and joint venture partners)

• Work collaboratively with data scientist colleagues to conceive and implement insightful analytical methods

Qualifications

title: Enterprise Risk Manager
description:
Enterprise Risk Manager

Location: Edinburgh (Hybrid) | Practice Area : Corporate Services | Department: Enterprise Risk | Type: Permanent

Strengthen enterprise-wide risk management and help shape a resilient, responsible future for Capco.

The Role

As Manager, Enterprise Risk, you will play a key role in strengthening and advancing Capco’s global Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework.

You will lead core elements of the framework, including Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), third-party risk, policy management, mandatory compliance training and governance. Working globally and cross-functionally across teams, you will help embed effective risk management into business strategy and operational processes.

As Capco continues to scale across geographies and services, including increasingly complex client engagements and the use of AI, you will help ensure risk oversight operates at a strategic, integrated and enterprise-wide level.

What You’ll Do

• Lead enterprise-wide and regional RCSAs, ensuring risks are clearly articulated and consistently rated, controls are appropriately assessed, and mitigating actions are tracked through to completion.

• Support the continued evolution and global implementation of Capco’s ERM framework, including scenario planning and emerging risk analysis across areas such as geopolitical, regulatory, cyber, AI-related and supply-chain risk.

• Design and implement a control-testing framework for high-risk processes, including Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABAC), and support other Internal Audits across the Enterprise Risk function.

• Own key compliance and governance activities, including the annual policy review, Policy Committee, conflicts of interest and gift registries, and mandatory compliance training.

• Work with Procurement and business owners to strengthen third-party risk management, including due diligence, ongoing assurance, remediation, supplier oversight and reporting to senior leadership.

description:
About the Role:
We’re building AI into STARLIMS, a platform used across quality manufacturing, life sciences, public health, forensics, and environmental sciences.
This role is focused on agentic systems: software that reasons over a task, calls tools, works through multiple steps, and hands the result to a person to review and approve.
Our users work under strict accuracy, traceability, and validation requirements. The engineering challenge is making non-deterministic systems reliable, observable, and controllable enough to be trusted, tested, and shipped.
You’ll work on both the platform and runtime our agents execute on and the production agents built on top of it.
What You’ll Work On:
Agent Platform & Runtime (Core Focus)

• Design and build the runtime our agents execute on: planning and execution loops, tool calling, state management, durable execution, and failure recovery

• Build the layer through which agents reach platform data and external systems safely

• Design coordination, delegation, and handoff across agents and workflows where needed

• Make agent behavior versionable, testable, measurable, and regression-safe across releases

• Build reusable primitives so new agents are configured rather than rebuilt from scratch

Building Agents (Core Focus)

• Take a domain workflow from expert conversation to a working agent: goals, actions, execution flow, failure handling, and success criteria

• Ground agent decisions and outputs in authoritative enterprise data rather than relying on model knowledge alone

• Implement human-in-the-loop by design, including approval gates, override capture, uncertainty handling, and clear evidence for agent decisions. Agents recommend and draft; people decide

• Close the loop: turn user corrections and overrides into signals that measurably improve the agent

Evaluation & Reliability

• Build evaluation harnesses for multi-step behavior, not single-response accuracy: task completion, tool-call correctness, groundedness, trajectory quality, and regression across model, prompt, and tool changes

• Define production metrics for agent quality, reliability, latency, cost, and human intervention rates

• Implement guardrails, fallbacks, timeouts, cost ceilings, and end-to-end observability and tracing across agent runs

• Design safeguards against prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, data leakage, and other agent-specific security risks

• Manage prompt evolution, model drift, and non-determinism while maintaining consistent, measurable system behavior across releases

Integration & Data

• Integrate agents with platform APIs and third-party enterprise systems already running in our customers’ environments

• Build retrieval and context pipelines that turn fragmented enterprise data into reliable, permission-aware agent context

• Design controlled execution paths for automated actions, with a complete, traceable audit trail

Platform & Infrastructure

• Build and operate backend services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, etc.)

• Own significant parts of the system architecture and contribute to key technical decisions

• Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines

Tech Stack

• Languages: TypeScript, Python

• Backend: Node.js, Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions

• AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and related agent/tool protocols, embeddings and vector search

• Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS

• Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform

• Testing: Jest, Playwright, pytest

What We’re Looking For
Must Have

• 6+ years of software engineering experience, including production systems

• Experience building production LLM systems, including tool-using or multi-step agentic workflows beyond simple prompting and chat interfaces

• Strong understanding of LLM behavior, limitations, and failure modes, especially how errors compound across a multi-step run

• Experience with LLM APIs, tool and function calling, and designing planning and exec

Requirements

Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns. Über uns Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut. Über die Rolle Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten. Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr. Woran du arbeiten wirst Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. description:

ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We're an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, R&D and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

ABOUT THE ROLE AT BABBEL LABS

We're a small, fast-moving team rethinking how people learn languages with AI. We're looking for a detail-oriented freelance Learning Content Reviewer to review American English content for German-speaking learners, making sure it's accurate, natural and explained in a way that works for them. This is a freelance role, paid hourly.

Speed, precision and quality are how we work. You'll review content as it's created, including content produced with the help of AI, and help us catch what machines miss. Your feedback will directly shape what learners experience and how our curriculum grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review learning content across formats. Check text, audio and images for accuracy, clarity, naturalness and consistency, and flag anything that could confuse or mislead a learner.

- Review and shape the curriculum. Assess how lessons build on each other, spot gaps or overlaps, and suggest improvements to structure, progression and learning goals.

- Ensure content reflects American English. Check spelling, vocabulary, idioms, pronunciation and cultural references for consistency with US conventions.

- Review content through a German learner's eyes. Check that German instructions, translations and explanations are accurate, and anticipate typical mistakes German speakers make in English.

- Quality-check AI-generated content. Evaluate content created with AI tools, identify recurring errors and help us improve how that content is produced.

- Give clear, actionable feedback. Document issues and suggestions in a way that content creators, linguists and engineers can act on quickly.

- Help raise the quality bar. Contribute to review guidelines, style standards and checklists that keep content consistent at scale.

- Work across disciplines with product managers, linguists, learning content strategists and engineers.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in at least one of the following: proofreading, translation, language teaching, or learning content quality testing.

- Language skills. Native or near-native American English and fluent German. Excellent oral and written communication skills in both.

- A sharp eye for detail. You notice the small things, from a mistranslated word to an audio clip that doesn't match its transcript.

- A learner-first mindset. You understand what makes content clear and motivating for someone learning a new language.

- Comfort with AI tools. You're curious about how AI is changing content creation and happy to use it as part of your workflow.

- Reliability and independence. You manage your own time, meet deadlines and communicate proactively when something needs attention.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You're happy working in a fast-changing environment where processes evolve as we learn.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- A consumer product used around the world. Your reviews directly improve a live product that real learners use every day, globally.

- Meaningful impact. Your feedback shapes the content and curriculum, not just the final polish.

- Competitive hourly rate. Pay that reflects your experience and the quality of your work.

Diversity at Babbel

As part of our ongoing journey towards building a diverse, equitable and inclusive company, we welcome everyone to apply, especially those individuals who are underrepresented in tech. We are a learning company, inside and out, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not fit all the technical requirements - all candidates are assessed based on skills, qualifications and on our business needs. title: Transformation Analyst
description: Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. How you’ll support Transformation across the NHS

title: Senior Analyst - DT Governance Risk And Compliance
description:
Digital Technology:

• 3 - 5 years of experience in IT Audit, IT Compliance, or Risk Management with a strong focus on SOX 404 ITGCs

• Deep knowledge of access controls (UAR, SOD, privileged access), change management, and IT operations controls within ITGC scope

• Hands-on experience with SOX testing methodologies (walkthroughs, sampling, evidence validation, re-performance)

• Familiarity with regulatory and audit standards such as PCAOB, COSO, COBIT

• Strong understanding of cloud/SaaS environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, etc.) and their SOX implications

• Experience with audit and compliance tools (e.g., ServiceNow IRM, SAP GRC)

• Strong analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify control deficiencies and propose remediation plans

• Effective communicator - able to draft clear narratives, RCMs, and walkthrough materials, and interface with auditors and control owners

Preferred Skills

• Certifications in CISA, CIA, CPA, CISSP, or equivalent experience are preferred

• Prior experience at a public company subject to SOX for SaaS or cloud-first environment

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Ljubljana, Slovenia
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
description:

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
Warum es diese Rolle gibt
DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
Deine Rolle
Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
Was du konkret machst

• Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

• OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

• Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

• Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

• User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

• Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

• Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

• Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Requirements
Das brauchst du

• Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

• Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

• Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

• Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

• Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

• Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu mach

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.
